newsitem.title: UK: UK'S Major admits Labour could win election.
newsitem.headline: UK'S Major admits Labour could win election.

text.p: British Prime Minister John Major said on Friday after his party's stunning defeat in a crucial parliamentary by-election that the opposition Labour party may win the coming election.
"If opinion does not change then we are going to have a Labour government," Major said in an interview with ITN television.
Labour's candidate in the by-election at Wirral South, north-west England, overturned a Conservative majority of 8,183 votes to win by a margin of 7,888 votes.
This forced Major's Conservative government into a minority in parliament and put Labour on course to win the election that must be called by May 22.
